allot.subject: Options to purchase securities
allot.text: Indo Amines Limited has informed the Exchange approval by the Nomination and Remuneration Committee and noting by the board, considered the Grant of 5,60,000 Stock Options under the Indo Amines Limited Employee Stock Option Plan 2025, to the eligible employees of the Company.

allot.subject: General Updates
allot.text: Indo Amines Limited has informed about the Allotment of Equity Shares pursuant to the Scheme of Amalgamation approved by the National Company Law Tribunal, Mumbai Bench
